newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Lehman starts four biotech stocks.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Lehman starts four biotech stocks.

text.p: Lehman Brothers said it initated coverage of four stocks in the biotechnology signal transduction sector.
-- rated Ligand Pharmaceuticals Inc a buy. Cadus Pharmaceutical Corp and ONYX Pharmaceuticals Inc were rated outperform.
-- put a venture rating on Ariad Pharmaceuticals Inc.

-- "we believe that understanding the pathways of the signaling process improves the pool of targets one may wish to direct highly specific, often orally available, and strongly potent drugs," a Lehman report said.
-- Ariad shares were up 1/4 at 6-1/4, Cadus shares were trading up 3/4 at 14-5/8, Onyx Pharmaceuticals was trading up 1/2 at 12 and Ligand Pharmaceutical was trading up 9/16 at 14-5/16.
